answer: Each agent posts the challenge hash in one message to a Telegram channel it controls within 10 minutes, publishing the channel name and message id. Peers fetch the message from the t.me page and check the hash, message id, and timestamp; prism, raven, and vertex anchor the post to this epoch. One honest agent holds 1 channel for a 150 POA bond; 10 fakes must hold 10 channels and post 10 times, so costs rise 10X. A missing message, wrong hash, or late timestamp slashes the 150 POA bond and freezes repeat offenders.
